newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy government beaten in vote on budget detail.
newsitem.headline: Italy government beaten in vote on budget detail.

text.p: Italy's Chamber of Deputies (lower house) passed an opposition amendment to a detail of the 1997 budget law setting tighter limits on provision of official cars in a defeat for the centre-left government on Friday.

The vote on entitlement to vehicles was 360 for to 61 against, suggesting many members from the governing benches had supported the amendment, proposed by centre-right opposition deputy Raffaele Costa.
It tightens limits on entitlement to official cars from those in the government's version and had been opposed by the government.

The change was not likely to have any significant impact on the 62.5 trillion lire package, which is being voted on by the house article by article before a final vote on the entire package expected next week. --Rome newsroom +39 6 6782505
